title: The band that paraded Huey Long and its drummers
summary: Manetta describes the band that paraded Huey Long from the train, the bass drum and snare players, and the drummer whose mother kept a cook shop stand.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
